selected.titulo: Google is launching a one-stop Gemini agent for your work tasks
selected.resumen:
Google is launching a "universal" Gemini AI agent that can work across apps and devices in the background. The tool, announced as part of the Gemini at Work event on Thursday, will be available within the Gemini Enterprise app, allowing users to chat with the Gemini agent and assign it tasks from a single interface.

selected.titulo: Cal AI’s 19-year-old founder just raised $10M for his new AI startup
selected.resumen: Zach Yadegari, the teen co-founder of popular Cal AI calorie tracking app, has launched a new personal AI agent startup that competes with Instinct, Muse, and Bee.

selected.titulo: Google brings agentic AI to Gemini, starting with businesses
selected.resumen: Google is turning Gemini into an AI agent that can plan, execute tasks, and work across business apps and systems. The agent can delegate work to subagents, use multiple AI models, and even gets its own workplace identity, complete with an email address.
